definitions.gloss: to hold back, to stop, to detain
definitions.explanation: To prevent someone from leaving or going somewhere.

definitions.gloss: to dissuade, to talk out of
definitions.explanation: To persuade someone not to do something, especially resigning or quitting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: My friend was about to leave, so I held them back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何|なん}とか→何とか：01126_nantoka⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧い。
examples.english: I want to somehow talk him out of resigning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴走|ぼうそう}→暴走：09481_bousou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{止|と}める⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was impossible to stop the runaway car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧、⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかんで→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I thought it was dangerous, so I grabbed their arm and held them back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{止|と}める⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The president raised salaries to retain talented employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えなかった→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Those around him tried to talk him out of it, but he didn't change his mind about studying abroad.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Compound verb: ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ + ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{止|と}める (hold back X / stop X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing effort. {引|ひ}き⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is trying to hold back' or 'is detaining.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{止|と}める (hold someone back)
- ⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{止|と}める (talk someone out of resigning)
- ⟦{何|なん}とか→何とか：01126_nantoka⟧{引|ひ}き{止|と}める (somehow try to stop/retain)

NOTE: Often used in workplace contexts when trying to prevent someone from quitting. Can also be written as {引|ひ}き⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧ with the same meaning.
